title: Optimal Stability Bounds, Minimizers, and Critical Points for a Critical Nonlocal Sobolev Inequality on the Heisenberg Group
summary: We investigate the optimal Bianchi-Egnell-type quantitative stability constant for the critical nonlocal Sobolev inequality on the Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}^{n}$, \begin{equation}\label{nS} S_{HL}(Q,μ)\left(\int_{\mathbb{H}^{n}}\int_{\mathbb{H}^{n}} \frac{|u(ξ)|^{Q^{\ast}_μ}|u(η)|^{Q^{\ast}_μ}} {|η^{-1}ξ|^μ}\,dξdη\right)^{\frac{1}{Q^{\ast}_μ}} \leq \int_{\mathbb{H}^{n}}|\nabla_{\mathbb{H}}u|^{2}dξ, \qquad u\in S^{1,2}(\mathbb{H}^{n}), \end{equation} where $Q=2n+2$, $n\geq1$, $0 H_{BE}$ with the optimal stability constant for the local Folland-Stein-Sobolev inequality.
